GENOGRAM BUILDER - how to use it
================================

OPENING IT
- Double-click "Genogram.html". It opens in your web browser (Safari or Chrome).
- It works without the internet and nothing gets installed.
- If the Mac asks which app to open it with, choose Safari.

THE BASICS
- Click a person's shape to select them. Their details show up on the right.
- Type their name, birth year and death year there.
- Under "Add new relative", use the buttons to add a partner, ex-partner,
  child, adopted child, parents or sibling. They're placed and connected for you.
- Drag any shape to move it.
- Scroll to zoom in and out. Drag an empty spot to move around the page.
- Made a mistake? Click "Undo" at the top.

JOINING TWO PEOPLE WHO ARE ALREADY ON THE CHART
1. At the top, pick the kind of line from the list next to "Link"
   (for example "Close", "Conflict", "Married" or "Siblings").
2. Click "Link".
3. Click the first person, then click the second person.

ETHNICITY
- Click a person. Under "Ethnicity", pick from the list, or type your own
  and click "Add". You can give someone more than one.
- Click the x on one to remove it.
- To hide ethnicity on the chart, click "Key & types" and untick
  "Show ethnicity under names".

SEEING AND CHANGING SOMEONE'S CONNECTIONS
- Click a person. The "Connections" section on the right lists everyone
  they're joined to: partners, parents, children, siblings and lines.
- Change a relationship or line type with its drop-down list, or type
  the years for a couple.
- "Reverse" flips which way an arrow points.
- The x removes that connection (Undo brings it back).
- Click a name to jump to that person.

MORE THAN ONE LINE BETWEEN TWO PEOPLE
- Two people can have several connection lines (for example "Close" and
  "Conflict"). Each one is drawn side by side in its own colour.
- Click a line, then use "+ Add" under "All lines between these two".

CONDITIONS, LINE TYPES AND BACKGROUND
- Click "Key & types" at the top.
- There you can add your own conditions (with a colour), make your own line
  types, and change the background colour and pattern.

SAVING YOUR WORK  (important)
- The browser remembers your chart, but to be safe click "Save" at the top.
  That puts a ".genogram.json" file in your Downloads folder.
- To keep working on it later, click "Open..." and choose that file.

MAKING A PDF
- Click "Export PDF..." at the top. A box opens where you choose the paper
  size and what to include, by ticking or unticking:
    * the chart itself (with or without the key)
    * a relationship summary that writes out in words how everyone is
      related (mother, cousin, in-laws and so on), plus each person's
      details, couples, children, connection lines, ethnicity and conditions
    * the guide explaining what every symbol and line means
- You can also tick "Save the relationship summary as a text file too".
- Click "Export PDF". The file(s) appear in your Downloads folder.
- The app remembers your choices for next time.
